setting.name: Blackthorn Village
setting.summary: A remote village cut off by strange events. Villagers have vanished, chanting drifts from the forest at night, and someone has been entering the old crypt.

locations.name: Village Square
locations.description: The heart of the village, where nervous villagers trade rumors.

locations.name: The Rusty Griffin
locations.description: A crowded tavern filled with nervous villagers.

locations.name: Church
locations.description: A cold stone church. The priest has been acting strangely.

locations.name: Crypt
locations.description: Steps beneath the church lead to the old crypt.

npcs.name: Aldric
npcs.personality: Suspicious, stubborn, protective of his daughter.
npcs.notes: Has a connection to the cult.

npcs.name: Mara
npcs.personality: Collects every rumor in the village.

npcs.name: Edwin
npcs.personality: Jumpy outsider who wants to leave.
